name: title
description: Short label naming this programme record.

aiGuidance.purpose: The 3-8 word noun phrase a reader scans in a tree, list or navigation sidebar to tell this record apart from its siblings. It is the record's identity in every rendered surface, so it has to be recognisable without the body.
aiGuidance.extraction: Take the subject the source material is actually about and compress it to a noun phrase. Drop leading articles, issue numbers and verbs of intent ("Rework...", "We should..."). If the source is a GitHub issue title, strip any prefix like "Epic:" or "[spec]" and keep the topic.
